title: The Blaschka Object Network — Global Archive Register Supplement: Upstream and Retrieval Archives
relationship_to_core: Supplement to sources/global-archive-register.json. These entries were identified after the first global register pass and are kept separate until the next canonical flattening audit.

entries.repository: Archivio Storico della Stazione Zoologica Anton Dohrn, Naples
entries.collection: Institutional archives of the Stazione Zoologica Anton Dohrn; Anton Dohrn personal archive
entries.reference: exact 4 February 1877 Blaschka item shelfmark pending retrieval
entries.direct_evidence: A Leopold Blaschka letter dated 4 February 1877 reportedly lists 41 preserved marine animals requested for glass-model construction; scholarship also cites March and November 1877 Dohrn archive documents.

entries.collection: Unterrichtsministerium, Allgemeine Reihe, Akten — Zoologische Station Triest
entries.direct_evidence: Rudolf Blaschka independently identifies the Trieste station as a supplier of living animals to the Dresden workshop; this ministry series is the exact administrative archive for the station during the relevant years.

entries.collection: Unterrichtsministerium, Allgemeine Reihe, Akten — Zoologische Station Neapel
research_use: Austrian state relation to Naples station
controlled comparison with Trieste under same ministry series
entries.guard: The presence of a Naples ministry file does not show that the 1877 Blaschka specimen purchase passed through the Austrian ministry.

entries.collection: Records of the Royal College of Science for Ireland

entries.repository: Illinois History and Lincoln Collections, University of Illinois Library
entries.guard: Auckland correspondence independently identifies Adams as the Blaschka carrier; the diary finding aid does not itself state that the models are mentioned.

entries.collection: Joseph Ashmead Clay and John Randolph Clay Papers
entries.guard: Pre-dates the documented Blaschka agency and concerns mineralogical material; retained as Damon business-practice control only.

entries.repository: Archivo del Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales, CSIC / Simurg
entries.collection: Robert F. Damon fossil/rock catalogues and species dispatch note
entries.guard: Catalogued material concerns fossils and rocks, not Blaschka glass models.
